equations.label: eq:target
equations.expr: p_t(x,c) = sum_j w_j N3(x; y_j, LambdaX_j) N3(c; d_j, LambdaC_j), w_j = 1/M_t
equations.invariant: normalized 6D mixture over the actual masked samples, full Gaussian normalizers, uniform 1/M_t selected by the PDF
equations.prohibited_substitution: nearest point, hard correspondence, unnormalized kernels, implicit sample weights

equations.label: eq:responsibility
equations.expr: r_j = a_j / sum_m a_m (stable log-sum-exp)
equations.invariant: responsibilities sum to one; density contributions only, not correspondences
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:targetscore
equations.expr: g_t(x,c) = sum_j r_j LambdaX_j^-1 (y_j - x)
equations.invariant: exact gradient of log p_t in x at fixed query colour, heteroscedastic

measured.basis: O(h^4) stencil, h=2e-5 m vs Lambda^1/2 ~ 3e-3 m

equations.prohibited_substitution: different Gaussian kernel, missing covariance inverse or colour factor

equations.label: eq:refcolour-marginal
equations.expr: int N3(c; d_j, LambdaC_j) N3(c; a_i, Sigma_a) dc = N3(a_i; d_j, LambdaC_j + Sigma_a)
equations.invariant: Gaussian convolution identity: reference colour uncertainty enters as LambdaC_j + Sigma_a (THEORY_CONFLICT TC-0001 choice)
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:physkernel
equations.expr: K(i,l) = exp(-1/2 dx^T HX^-1 dx - 1/2 dc^T HC^-1 dc)
equations.invariant: SPD XYZ-RGB interaction kernel, bandwidths distinct from Lambda and R
equations.prohibited_substitution: dropping colour, depth-dependent bandwidth without a model

equations.label: eq:repulsion
equations.expr: grad_{x_l} K(l,i) = K(l,i) HX^-1 (x_i - x_l)
equations.invariant: correct sign: pushes x_i away from x_l
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:physicalsvgd
equations.expr: Phi_i = 1/N sum_{l=1..N} [K(l,i) g(x_l,c_l) + K(l,i) HX^-1 (x_i - x_l)];  x <- x + eta Phi (accepted only if the common objective decreases)
equations.invariant: entire sum over all N particles, global 1/N, attraction/repulsion stored separately, colour fixed

measured.basis: float64; repulsion relative to max(|rep|, 1e-3 x summand scale eps|x'| sum K ||H^-1||/N)

measured.tolerance: 1e-4 x displacement (Krylov-amplified roundoff; Stein step alone agrees to 1e-18 m)

equations.prohibited_substitution: degree normalization, neighbour-only sum, repulsion removal, unreported clipping

equations.label: eq:svgd-standard
equations.expr: standard SVGD on samples of ONE target (Liu & Wang 2016), reference only
equations.invariant: physical particles are not posterior samples: no KL-theorem claim for support inference
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:featureobs-mean
equations.expr: y^F_t = 1/M_t sum_j psi(y_j, d_j)
equations.invariant: observed feature mean over all masked samples
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:featurepred
equations.expr: h_t(X_t, V_t) = 1/|V_t| sum_{i in V_t} psi(x_it, c_i)
equations.invariant: comparable VISIBLE predicted support; V_t law not defined in theory
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:featureobs
equations.expr: y^F_t = h_t + eps_t, eps_t ~ N_D(0, Gamma_t)
equations.invariant: Gamma_t must be estimated from data and the declared feature construction
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:featcost
equations.expr: E_F,t = 1/2 e^T Gamma^-1 e + 1/2 log det(2 pi Gamma)
equations.invariant: single normalized feature likelihood per frame; never raw + weighted MMD twice
equations.prohibited_substitution: unweighted + weighted MMD as two measurements; diagonal Gamma called exact

equations.label: eq:featgrad
equations.expr: grad_{x_i} log p = 1/|V| J_psi(x_i,c_i)^T Gamma^-1 (y^F - h)
equations.invariant: matrix-free JVP/VJP, conditional on frozen V_t

measured.tolerance: 1e-13 / 1e-7 (central FD O(h^2), h=1e-6 m vs B^1/2 >= 1.6e-2 m)

equations.prohibited_substitution: feature replacement, fixed denominator with changing support, untracked RFF approximation

equations.label: eq:mmd
equations.expr: MMD^2 = ||1/N sum psi(x_i,c_i) - 1/M sum psi(y_j,d_j)||^2 (exact Gaussian product kernel, CPU oracle)
equations.invariant: finite RFF map is the DECLARED feature model psi (TF.5 exception), not the infinite kernel

measured.basis: finite map is the declared model; agreement with the infinite kernel only to MC accuracy

equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: visibility-law
equations.expr: p(V | X_0:T, C) (not specified)
equations.invariant: occluded point never measured by its occluder; no V_t=0 from leaving the basin

measured.note: DEV-0001 failure mode exposed, not fixed

equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: unexplained-support
equations.expr: B_t latent new/unrepresented observed support (not specified)
equations.invariant: newly exposed geometry is not forced onto old IDs
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: sampling-density
equations.expr: camera-overlap / footprint sampling model (not specified); 1/M_t is the PDF baseline
equations.invariant: duplicate cameras are not independent area
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:temporalprior
equations.expr: E_time = 1/2 sum_i |s_i0 - s0bar_i|^2_{P_i0^-1} + 1/2 sum_t sum_i |s_it - F_t s_i,t-1|^2_{Q_t^-1}; F,Q white acceleration (point_kalman_cuda)
equations.invariant: actual timestamps, shared frame-0 source covariance once, declared velocity prior

measured.basis: block-Thomas vs dense Hessian, condition of L ~1e10

equations.prohibited_substitution: independent frame-to-frame registration as sequence inference

equations.label: eq:rigid
equations.expr: |x_it - x_lt| = |x_i0 - x_l0| under common SE(3)
equations.invariant: no pivot/axis/part centre
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:distdiff
equations.expr: (x_i - x_l)^T (v_i - v_l) = 0
equations.invariant: check on estimated motion, not a measurement
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:edgeresid
equations.expr: e_il,t = |x_it - x_lt| - |x_i0 - x_l0|
equations.invariant: complete history, no self/coincident edges
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:edge-delta
equations.expr: de = n_t^T (dx_it - dx_lt) - n_0^T (dx_i0 - dx_l0)
equations.invariant: exact first-order Jacobian
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:edge-cov
equations.expr: Omega_il = J P_zeta J^T; production: shared-reference exact, trajectory states independent across time and points (rank-1 + diagonal)
equations.invariant: shared frame-0 reference counted once; Sherman-Morrison inverse/log det exact for that structure
equations.prohibited_substitution: treating distances at different frames or edges as independent

equations.label: eq:rigidlik
equations.expr: p(e | H^R) = N_T(e; 0, Omega + Omega_model)
equations.invariant: conditional likelihood only, not a posterior; static pairs also satisfy it
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:edgepost
equations.expr: w_il = P(z_il = 1 | Q_0:T)
equations.invariant: coherent partition, not independent Bernoulli edges
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:fullpost
equations.expr: p(X,m,Z,V,B | Q) ~ p(Q | X,V,B) p(X | m,Z) p(V,B,m,Z)
equations.invariant: one posterior, one observation model
equations.prohibited_substitution: independent edge probabilities as a partition; energies summed as posterior

equations.label: eq:marginal
equations.expr: gamma_i = sum_{m_-i,Z} int p(..., m_i=1, ... | Q)
equations.invariant: exact enumeration on tiny hypothesis sets
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:hypotheses
equations.expr: H0: x_t = x_0; H1: x_t = R_t x_0 + b_t (latent, identity at frame 0, proper random-walk prior)
equations.invariant: same observations and noise under both; extra freedom penalized by integration
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:evidence
equations.expr: L^h = int p(y | Theta, H^h) p(Theta | H^h) dTheta
equations.invariant: closed form (linear Gaussian) vs quadrature oracle
equations.prohibited_substitution: MAP improvement, sigmoid of displacement/Stein norm, p-value as probability

equations.label: eq:bayes
equations.expr: P(H1 | y) = pi L1 / (pi L1 + (1 - pi) L0) (log-sum-exp)
equations.invariant: p_static + p_dynamic = 1 only for the complete binary model
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:laplace
equations.expr: log L ~ -E(theta*) + d/2 log 2 pi - 1/2 log det Hess
equations.invariant: only with all normalizers and PD Hessian; error vs quadrature reported
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:jointobjective
equations.expr: E = sum_t E_F,t - log p_motion + 1/2 sum z e^T Omega^-1 e - log p(m,Z,V,B) + C_norm; production trajectory step uses E_obs + E_time only
equations.invariant: conditional trajectory objective; rigidity/support/visibility terms not in the accepted-step objective
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:seedrisk
equations.expr: FDR(S) = sum_{i in S} (1 - gamma_i) / max(1, |S|) <= alpha
equations.invariant: only on established posteriors; IDs are original IDs
equations.prohibited_substitution: near-hinge labels from GT/joint axis; fake legacy outputs

equations.label: eq:hinge
equations.expr: |x_t - x_0| = 2 r |sin(theta/2)|
equations.invariant: used only to build evaluation fixtures
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: eq:increments
equations.expr: Cov(dz_t, dz_t+1) = -R for i.i.d. errors
equations.invariant: noise study, not a residual
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

equations.label: stages-2-4
equations.expr: rigid recovery, joint identification, support completion
equations.invariant: no fake downstream outputs
equations.prohibited_substitution: any change without a deviation record

matrix-free JVP/VJP, point-chunked, no N x D Jacobian

theory_conflicts.theory: PDF (3),(8),(11): reference colour c_i is a fixed vector; the score is evaluated at the fixed query colour.
theory_conflicts.spec: Spec 1.1/3.2: "Propagate uncertainty of a_i; it is not noise-free"; Cov(a_i) must enter colour comparison once.
theory_conflicts.consequence: fixed c_i: colour flicker of the reference is attributed to the target bandwidth only; marginalized: N3(a_i; d_j, LambdaC_j + Sigma_a) (exact Gaussian convolution) broadens every colour factor by the same shared reference covariance.
theory_conflicts.implementation: target_score(query_color_cov=None) = PDF; query_color_cov=Sigma_a = spec. Config key reference.color_reference_uncertainty selects; strict mode refuses to run TARGET while the choice is NOT_DEFINED_IN_THEORY.
